events.text:
T-213 is in review. The warm-up job waits on Tantra, the worker is deployed and the lead email works. I did not push, because local main and `origin/main` have diverged.

- **Instantly removed:** the start-endy warm-up job now waits for inboxes to show Connected and Gmail capable in Tantra Accounts. `cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs` passes and `tsc` is clean. The probe covers the start-endy path only. The older Instantly campaign code in `dashboard.ts`, `jobs-day2.ts` and `jobs-event.ts` is still there, so `cloud/src` as a whole is not Instantly-free.
- **Deployed:** the centre worker is live from a clean worktree of the committed code, version 490bdac1.
- **Lead email:** `workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py` sends one email per new Inbox Partner Leads row, each only once. It goes to `ENDY_LEAD_EMAIL`, or to adi@growthclub.org until Endy gives an address. I wrote the `endy-test-lead` row, confirmed its email landed in the team inbox, and deleted the row. I did not add the view-only sheet share fallback.
- **Not pushed:** local main is 144 commits ahead of and 29 behind `origin/main`, so a push would be rejected and a force push is not allowed. It needs a merge first.
- **Call brief:** `workshop-plan/ops/endy-call-brief.md` covers the hand-off, a proposed 20% recurring revenue share, delivery into Tantra via the client ID and three scopes, and pricing and turnaround. It also says start-endy is now the only cold inbox path (T-299). Nelbin holds the call and records the agreement in the task log.

The commit is `8737754`.
